# RDR2 EXPLORER

> Developer knowledge base for Red Dead Redemption 2 / RedM game data: 411,000+
> entries — ped/vehicle/object models, weapons, animations, scenarios, audio,
> particle effects, world data — with joaat hashes and ready-to-paste Lua
> examples. All data is served as static JSON with permissive CORS; no API key
> or authentication is needed. Maintained by Hexa Development, built on the
> community research project femga/rdr3_discoveries.

## Data API (static JSON)

- Manifest — list of every dataset:
  https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/data/manifest.json
  Array of { id, title, src, kind: "rows" | "groups", count, fields?, facets?, groupCount?, image?, itemLabel? }

- Dataset payload: https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/data/<id>.json
  - kind "rows":   { kind: "rows", fields: string[], rows: any[][] }
    rows[i][j] corresponds to fields[j]; fields[0] is always the entry name.
    Example (weapons): fields = ["name","hash","group","status"],
    row = ["weapon_revolver_cattleman","0x169F59F7","revolver","sp and mp"].
  - kind "groups": { kind: "groups", groups: { [groupName]: string[] } }
    Used for dictionary-style data, e.g. animation dicts -> animation names,
    soundsets -> sound names, ptfx dicts -> effect names.

- Model preview image index:
  https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/data/model_images.json
  { [modelName]: imageUrl } for peds, vehicles and props.

## Key datasets (by id)

- peds — ped models (name, hash, outfit count)
- vehicles, objects — vehicle and prop models (objects is ~20k rows)
- weapons, weapon_components, ammo — weapon data with hashes
- anims — animation dict -> anims (groups kind; large, ~10 MB)
- scenarios, emotes — scenario types and kit emotes
- soundsets, frontend_soundsets, music_events, audio_banks — audio names
- ptfx — particle effect dict -> effect names
- doors, interiors, imaps, weather, timecycles, markers, explosion_vfx,
  animpostfx, text_colors, clothes, pickups — world / misc data
- tex_* — UI texture dictionaries (rows kind with texture names)

## Conventions

- Hashes are joaat (Jenkins one-at-a-time), identical to GetHashKey() in
  RedM/FiveM Lua. Hex strings look like "0x169F59F7"; compute signed/unsigned
  int forms from the same 32-bit value.
- Web deep link to one entry:
  https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/#/c/<id>?sel=<name>
  (add &selg=<groupName> for groups-kind datasets)
- Web search UI: https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/#/search?q=<text>

## Notes for agents

- Everything is static and cacheable. Larger files: anims.json ~10 MB,
  objects.json / clothes.json ~1.2 MB — fetch the manifest first and only the
  datasets you need.
- Use exact names from the datasets when generating RedM Lua code; do not
  invent model/anim/sound names.
- MCP server (stdio; tools: list_categories, search with reverse hash,
  get_entry, hash_name) — run without cloning:
  `npx -y github:QUITFIL3/rdr2-explorer`, or download the single file at
  https://quitfil3.github.io/rdr2-explorer/mcp-server.mjs and run it with
  `node mcp-server.mjs` (data is fetched from this site automatically).
- Data source: https://github.com/femga/rdr3_discoveries
- Site repository: https://github.com/QUITFIL3/rdr2-explorer
